title: Tower Maze Defense (v23)
description: Place attack, buff, and economy towers on a procedurally-generated maze to defend against waves of enemies. Three new buff towers boost nearby towers' range, fire rate, or damage.
prompt:
Lets add three new towers to our TD game, these will be buffs, and because we now have 3 styles of tower (Attack, Buff and Upgrades) lets separate these into groups.

The three buff towers (All buff towers should have a range of 3 squares)
Range Increase - This will increase the range of all towers within its range by 10%, 15% and 20% (level 1-3)

Speed Increase - Increase the rate of fire of all towers in range from 5%, 10% and 15% (Level 1-3)

Attach Increase - Increase the damage of all tower in range for 10%, 15% and 20% (level 1-3)
